name: smstunnel
description: Send texts (SMS) from your own Android phone and your own number: one recipient per text, your OK before anything is sent, delivery status, sign-in codes and replies.

settings.name: SMSTunnel key
settings.description: From https://dashboard.smstunnel.io/apps: Apps → Add an app. It is kept in your system's keychain.

settings.name: Default country code (optional)
settings.description: For example +40 or 1: completes numbers written without + or 00. Press Enter to skip and always use international numbers.
